about.title: About Me
about.name: Nattakit Kerdtalay (Max)
about.bio: I have a deep passion for computer technology and a strong commitment to continuously developing new skills. Although my academic background is in Industrial Engineering, I made a deliberate and determined decision to transition into the field of software development. I aspire to apply all of my knowledge, capabilities, and available tools to create value, build efficient systems, and develop meaningful innovations that contribute positively to our society and country.
